title: CPU frequency can't reach the SPEC under high workload
configuration:
CPU: AMD Zen4
DIMM: DDR5 5600
OS: Linux
description: SPEC define the CPU frequency is 5GHz, but test result maximum is 4.8GHz.
steps:
1. Boot to OS
2. Run CPU stress / benchmark tool
3. Check CPU frequency through turbostat/MSR
rootcause: Power limit parameter (PPT/TDC/EDC) setting in CBS

title: PCIe Gen5 device link training failure on cold boot
configuration:
CPU: AMD Zen4 Server
DIMM: DDR5 RDIMM
OS: Linux
PCIe Card: Gen5 NVMe AIC
description: System occasionally drops link speed to Gen4 or fails link training during cold boot.
steps:
1. Install PCIe Gen5 device into Slot 1
2. AC power cycle 20 times
3. Check lspci link status
rootcause: PCIe Preset EQ setting needs tuning for channel loss

title: Memory training hang at POST Code 0x55 with 12-channel populated
configuration:
CPU: AMD Zen5 Server
DIMM: 12x 64GB DDR5 RDIMM 6000MT/s
OS: Linux
description: System intermittently hangs during MRC memory training when all 12 memory channels are fully populated.
steps:
1. Populate all 12 channels with 64GB RDIMM
2. Trigger reboot in a loop
3. Observe MRC hang at POST code 0x55
rootcause: VREF / ODT drive strength requires update in newer AGESA release

title: CXL 2.0 Type 3 memory device not mapped into E820 table
configuration:
CPU: Intel Xeon 6
DIMM: DDR5 RDIMM
CXL Device: CXL 2.0 Memory Expander
description: After enabling CXL in BIOS Setup, the CXL memory range is detected in PCIe config space but CEDT / SRAT tables are not properly updated for OS mapping.
steps:
1. Plug in CXL Type 3 device
2. Enable CXL in Advanced Setup
3. Boot Linux and check /proc/iomem and dmesg
rootcause: CEDT ACPI table generator had a bug when calculating memory range base address
